verdict.rationale: Coinbase documents an official MCP server built into the CDP CLI (`cdp mcp`) that exposes every API endpoint as a tool. It also documents a separate Coinbase Wallet MCP that lets any AI check balances, send funds, swap tokens, sign messages and pay with x402. A probe confirmed the official MCP documentation page is live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully, and detailed evidence of setup, auth and tool scoping for the MCP server.
